name: rail-yard-equipment
about: A sound square ad: a white tractor at a fuel island at night. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `rail` look (left rule, Barlow Condensed headline, drawn button, the kit's band at the foot): the same photo, words and kit as `clean-yard-equipment`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: nothing planted: a night scene, the truck legible, the kit's colours

subject_legible.reason: A white sleeper tractor under bright fuel-canopy lights stands out sharply against the dark night and reads instantly as a truck.

words_match_picture.reason: A general call for Class A OTR drivers sits over a sleeper tractor at a fuel stop at night, which fits over-the-road work well.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The big white headline on the green wash is read first, the white Apply Now button second, and the truck sits above without fighting the words.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark green wash, green footer band and white button and type match the brand colours exactly, though no carrier name or logo appears.
